WITH invoices_per_gender AS (
    SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
    FROM Invoices AS i
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.gender
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count
    FROM invoices_per_gender
)
SELECT AVG(g.invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count_above_overall,
       AVG(g.invoice_count - a.avg_invoice_count) AS avg_excess_over_overall
FROM invoices_per_gender AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a
WHERE g.invoice_count > a.avg_invoice_count;

assumptions.assumption: Customers with no invoices are excluded because the request counts invoices linked through each order to its customer; missing gender among customers with invoices is grouped as its own value.
